candidates.change_summary: Replace the require condition to check that msg.sender is NOT the owner, reversing the access control so only non-owners can call withdrawAll.
Replace the transfer target to send funds to msg.sender instead of the provided _recipient, changing the recipient of the withdrawal.
Replace the transfer call to send zero wei (no funds) to the recipient instead of the contract balance, preventing any funds from being transferred.
Replace the transfer amount to send only half of the contract balance (using division by 2) to the recipient instead of the full balance.
Insert an extra transfer sending the contract balance to owner before transferring to the provided recipient, altering final balances and observable behavior.
Replace the require with a revert message, making the same check but changing the revert string (observable via revert reason).
